pattern: {p:Player} discard[s] ( their hand | all the cards in their hand ) , then draw[s] that many cards minus {k:Qty}
subject: player

examples.text: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus two.
Target player discards their hand, then draws that many cards minus one. You gain 2 life.

counterExamples: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards plus two.
Each player discards all the cards in their graveyard, then draws that many cards minus two.
Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then you draw that many cards minus two.

pattern: {p:Player} discard[s] their hand , then draw[s] cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way
subject: player

examples.text: Each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way. You lose 2 life.
When this creature enters, each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.

counterExamples: Each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the smallest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Each player discards their hand, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player drew this way.
Each player discards their graveyard, then draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
